headline: Log every step. Spot the pattern. Celebrate the win.

features.title: One-tap logging
features.text: Pee, poop, accidents, sits, drinks and food, logged in a second, even with one hand full.

features.title: Smart predictions
features.text: We learn your child's rhythm, including how long after a drink they usually need to go, and nudge you before the next likely potty time.

features.title: Clear progress
features.text: Success rate, dry streaks, intake vs output and busiest hours, so you can see what is working.

features.title: Share with caregivers
features.text: Parents, grandparents and daycare stay in sync on the same log.

features.title: Food, fluids and poop
features.text: Spot patterns between what your child eats and drinks and how easily they go.

features.title: Expert-style guides
features.text: Readiness checklists, first-week routines and what to do about accidents. Free to read.

steps: Set their age and the day you start.
Record each potty visit, accident, drink and snack as it happens.
Get predictions, streaks and a plan that adapts.
